{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter out refunded orders (only completed orders count as conversions)
completed_only = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Verify: no QA orders (revenue = 999999.99) are present
assert (completed_only['revenue'] == '999999.99').sum() == 0, 'QA orders found in completed dataset'

# Now compute conversion rate by channel
conversion_rates = completed_only.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Extract rates
total_converted_email = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email']['converted'].sum()
total_orders_email = len(completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'email'])
total_converted_paid_search = completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search']['converted'].sum()
total_orders_paid_search = len(completed_only[completed_only['channel'] == 'paid_search'])

# Compute difference in conversion rates
rate_email = total_converted_email / total_orders_email
rate_paid_search = total_converted_paid_search / total_orders_paid_search
rate_diff = rate_email - rate_paid_search

print(f'Conversion rate (email): {rate_email:.4f}')
print(f'Conversion rate (paid_search): {rate_paid_search:.4f}')
print(f'Difference (email - paid_search): {rate_diff:.4f}')"}
